name: ardanlabs
description: Ardan Labs skills for Go, layered architecture, and PR review.

plugins.name: use-modern-go
plugins.description: Apply modern Go syntax guidelines based on the project's Go version.

plugins.name: layered-architecture-types
plugins.description: Enforce primitives-at-edges / strong-types-in-Business layering and the toBus/fromBusResponse/toDB converter pattern.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Read-only PR review lenses for security, feature completeness, correctness, error visibility, comments, tests, contracts, duplication, and simplification.
